summary.caption: A black-and-white Japanese manga page, read right to left, panels separated by clean white gutters, crisp ink line art, screentone shading. Four panels: a young woman with long black hair in a school uniform at a rainy train station turns back and hesitates before boarding.

items.label: object
items.caption: Panel 1, long shot: a rainy train station platform at dusk, a young woman with long black hair in a school uniform seen from behind walking toward the open train door.

items.label: object
items.caption: Panel 2, medium close-up: a young woman with long black hair in a school uniform stops at the train door and turns her head back over her shoulder.

items.label: object
items.caption: Panel 3, extreme close-up of a young woman with long black hair in a school uniform's eyes, hesitant expression, rain drops.

items.label: text
items.caption: A white vertical speech bubble with Chinese text "那个……"

items.label: object
items.caption: Panel 4, medium shot: a young woman with long black hair in a school uniform gives a faint sad smile inside the train doorway.

items.label: text
items.caption: A white vertical speech bubble with Chinese text "没什么。再见。"
